create_TactilePushingTrainer: create a TactilePushingTrainer instance with config, experiment path, and device for tactile pose estimation training
run_compute_loss: run compute_loss on the trainer to perform forward pass and compute SE2 pose estimation loss
test_get_batch_data: test get_batch_data to prepare Theseus optimization inputs from a batch of tactile pushing data
review_pack_batch_results: review pack_batch_results static method that clones and packs Theseus outputs with model state dicts and timing info
refactor_update_backward: refactor the _update method to modify gradient clipping and parameter clamping for the tactile models
